references.text: Previous verse describing whom the Israelites could buy as slaves from the surrounding nations
Prohibition against treating Israelite brothers as slaves and command not to rule over them harshly (בְּפָרֶךְ)
The same expression בְּפָרֶךְ (harshly) is used regarding how the Egyptians treated the Israelites
Ezekiel condemns shepherds who ruled over the flock harshly (בְּפָרֶךְ)
Law of inheritance stating that property should remain within the tribe as a permanent possession (אֲחֻזָּה)
Law requiring the release of Hebrew slaves after six years, referencing that they themselves were slaves in Egypt
Laws concerning Hebrew slaves and their release
Jeremiah condemns Israel for failing to free their Hebrew brothers from slavery
Prophetic call to set the oppressed free from bondage
